# Check for missing values in the education column
missing_education = df[education_column].isnull().sum()
missing_education

# Drop rows with missing values in the education column
df_clean = df.dropna(subset=[education_column])

# Convert gender to a numerical variable for analysis (1: Male, 2: Female)

# Perform a t-test to compare the mean highest grade completed between genders
import scipy.stats as stats

male_grades = df_clean[df_clean[gender_column] == 1][education_column]
female_grades = df_clean[df_clean[gender_column] == 2][education_column]
